tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of the Topcoatly dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of the Topcoatly dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of the Topcoatly dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of the Topcoatly dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given, for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Topcoatly dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Topcoatly dataset by a numeric column: "which is the most/least X".

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Topcoatly dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dataset_compare" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
